description: Hamburger Trinkwasserdatenbank (ZTEIS) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. In the drinking water database ZTEIS (central drinking water recording and information system), test results are collected, which are carried out by the drinking water laboratory of the Hamburger Wasserwerke in accordance with § 14 Drinking Water Ordinance (TrinkwV) and by the Institute for Hygiene and Environment in accordance with § 19 TrinkwV. Coverage: DE. Its keywords include Trinkwasseranalyse, ENVI, ZTEIS, Trinkwasseruntersuchungsstelle, Probenentnahme, Überprüfung. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
